theorem matching_receipt_follows_switch (r : Receipt) (b p v s a n : Nat)
    (files : Nat → Option Nat) (h : Matches r b p v s a n files) : a < r.observed

theorems.name: PublicationProofs.collection_step_preserves_live_roots
theorems.statement:
theorem collection_step_preserves_live_roots (roots : Nat → Bool) (a b : Storage)
    (h : Protected roots a) (step : Step roots a b) : Protected roots b

theorems.name: PublicationProofs.every_interrupted_prefix_preserves_roots
theorems.statement:
theorem every_interrupted_prefix_preserves_roots (roots : Nat → Bool) (a b : Storage)
    (h : Protected roots a) (run : Run roots a b) : Protected roots b

theorems.name: PublicationProofs.transitive_dependencies_survive
theorems.statement:
theorem transitive_dependencies_survive (root : Nat → Prop) (edge : Nat → Nat → Prop)
    (marked : Nat → Bool) (a b : Storage)
    (start : ∀ x, root x → marked x = true)
    (closed : ∀ x y, marked x = true → edge x y → marked y = true)
    (safe : Protected marked a) (run : Run marked a b)
    (x : Nat) (reachable : PlanMigrationProofs.Reachable root edge x) : b.live x = true

theorems.name: PublicationProofs.partial_unlink_retry_idempotent
theorems.statement:
theorem partial_unlink_retry_idempotent (s : Storage) (id x : Nat) :
    PlanMigrationProofs.remove (PlanMigrationProofs.remove s.trash id) id x =
    PlanMigrationProofs.remove s.trash id x

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.new_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem new_iff (p r c t n o : Bool) :
    select p r c t n o = ok Selection.New ↔
      p = true ∧ r = true ∧ c = true ∧ t = true ∧ n = true

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.old_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem old_iff (p r c t n o : Bool) :
    select p r c t n o = ok Selection.Old ↔
      p = true ∧ o = true ∧ ¬(r = true ∧ c = true ∧ t = true ∧ n = true)

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.invalid_plan_holds
theorems.statement:
theorem invalid_plan_holds (r c t n o : Bool) :
    select false r c t n o = ok Selection.Hold

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.torn_record_uses_old
theorems.statement:
theorem torn_record_uses_old (c t n : Bool) :
    select true false c t n true = ok Selection.Old

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.pending_record_uses_old
theorems.statement:
theorem pending_record_uses_old (r t n : Bool) :
    select true r false t n true = ok Selection.Old

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.stale_commit_uses_old
theorems.statement:
theorem stale_commit_uses_old (r c n : Bool) :
    select true r c false n true = ok Selection.Old

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.invalid_candidate_uses_old
theorems.statement:
theorem invalid_candidate_uses_old (r c t : Bool) :
    select true r c t false true = ok Selection.Old

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.neither_verified_holds
theorems.statement:
theorem neither_verified_holds (p r c t : Bool) :
    select p r c t false false = ok Selection.Hold

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.new_requires_bound_commit
theorems.statement:
theorem new_requires_bound_commit (p r c t n o : Bool)
    (h : select p r c t n o = ok Selection.New) :
    p = true ∧ r = true ∧ c = true ∧ t = true ∧ n = true

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.old_requires_verified_plan
theorems.statement:
theorem old_requires_verified_plan (p r c t n o : Bool)
    (h : select p r c t n o = ok Selection.Old) : p = true ∧ o = true

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.verified_old_has_selection
theorems.statement:
theorem verified_old_has_selection (r c t n : Bool) :
    select true r c t n true = ok Selection.Old ∨ select true r c t n true = ok Selection.New

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.start_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem start_iff (chosen requested : Selection) (boot plan : Bool) :
    start_allowed chosen requested boot plan = ok true ↔
      boot = true ∧ plan = true ∧ chosen ≠ Selection.Hold ∧ chosen = requested

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.mutually_exclusive_start
theorems.statement:
theorem mutually_exclusive_start (chosen : Selection) (boot plan : Bool)
    (old : start_allowed chosen Selection.Old boot plan = ok true) :
    start_allowed chosen Selection.New boot plan ≠ ok true

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.previous_boot_permit_denied
theorems.statement:
theorem previous_boot_permit_denied (chosen requested : Selection) (plan : Bool) :
    start_allowed chosen requested false plan = ok false

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.previous_plan_permit_denied
theorems.statement:
theorem previous_plan_permit_denied (chosen requested : Selection) (boot : Bool) :
    start_allowed chosen requested boot false = ok false

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.stop_requires_durable_guard
theorems.statement:
theorem stop_requires_durable_guard (plan guard old : Bool)
    (h : stop_old_allowed plan guard old = ok true) : plan = true ∧ guard = true ∧ old = true

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.trial_cannot_survive_reboot
theorems.statement:
theorem trial_cannot_survive_reboot (plan timer : Bool) (elapsed : U64) :
    trial_allowed false plan timer elapsed = ok false

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.trial_cannot_extend_deadline
theorems.statement:
theorem trial_cannot_extend_deadline (boot plan timer : Bool) (elapsed : U64)
    (h : 900000000000 ≤ elapsed.val) : trial_allowed boot plan timer elapsed = ok false

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.fallback_requires_verified_failure
theorems.statement:
theorem fallback_requires_verified_failure (selected boot plan failed old : Bool)
    (h : fallback_allowed selected boot plan failed old = ok true) :
    selected = true ∧ boot = true ∧ plan = true ∧ failed = true ∧ old = true

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.boot_choice_new_iff
theorems.statement:
theorem boot_choice_new_iff (record : Record) (newValid : Bool) :
    bootChoice record newValid = ok Selection.New ↔ record = .committed ∧ newValid = true

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.boot_choice_old_unless_checked_commit
theorems.statement:
theorem boot_choice_old_unless_checked_commit (record : Record) (newValid : Bool)
    (notCommitted : record ≠ .committed) : bootChoice record newValid = ok Selection.Old

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.temporary_never_becomes_recovery_record
theorems.statement:
theorem temporary_never_becomes_recovery_record (disk : Disk) (value recovered : Record) :
    CrashOutcome (stage disk value) recovered ↔ CrashOutcome disk recovered

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.file_sync_alone_never_promotes
theorems.statement:
theorem file_sync_alone_never_promotes (disk : Disk) (recovered : Record) :
    CrashOutcome (syncFile disk) recovered ↔ CrashOutcome disk recovered

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.unsynced_temporary_cannot_rename
theorems.statement:
theorem unsynced_temporary_cannot_rename (disk : Disk) (value : Record) :
    rename (stage disk value) = stage disk value

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.no_committed_name_no_promotion
theorems.statement:
theorem no_committed_name_no_promotion (disk : Disk) (recovered : Record) (newValid : Bool)
    (crash : CrashOutcome disk recovered) (old : disk.durable ≠ .committed)
    (visible : disk.visible ≠ .committed) : bootChoice recovered newValid = ok Selection.Old

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.renamed_commit_recovers_only_verified_target
theorems.statement:
theorem renamed_commit_recovers_only_verified_target (disk : Disk) (recovered : Record)
    (newValid : Bool) (crash : CrashOutcome disk recovered)
    (selected : bootChoice recovered newValid = ok Selection.New) :
    recovered = .committed ∧ newValid = true ∧
      (disk.durable = .committed ∨ disk.visible = .committed)

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.directory_sync_agrees_on_committed_record
theorems.statement:
theorem directory_sync_agrees_on_committed_record (disk : Disk)
    (committed : disk.visible = .committed) :
    (syncDirectory disk).durable = .committed ∧ (syncDirectory disk).visible = .committed

theorems.name: RecoveryProofs.torn_record_falls_back_after_any_write
theorems.statement:
theorem torn_record_falls_back_after_any_write (newValid : Bool) :
    bootChoice .invalid newValid = ok Selection.Old

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.generated_eq

theorem generated_eq (u t e : Slice U8) (rootAlias : Bool) :

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.generated_contract

theorem generated_contract (u t e : Slice U8) (rootAlias : Bool) :

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.generated_exact_entry
theorems.statement:
theorem generated_exact_entry (u t e : Slice U8) (rootAlias : Bool)
    (h : release.generated_rule u t e rootAlias = ok true) : t.val = e.val

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.generated_no_extra_url
theorems.statement:
theorem generated_no_extra_url (u t e : Slice U8)
    (h : release.generated_rule u t e false = ok true) : u.val.drop 1 = e.val

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.generated_safe_target
theorems.statement:
theorem generated_safe_target (u t e : Slice U8) (rootAlias : Bool)
    (h : release.generated_rule u t e rootAlias = ok true) : targetCanonical t.val = true

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.generated_total

theorem generated_total (u t e : Slice U8) (rootAlias : Bool) :
    ∃ b, release.generated_rule u t e rootAlias = ok b

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.commit_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem commit_eq (c e : Slice U8) (p s d : Bool) :
    release.commit_allowed c e p s d = ok (decide (commitPolicy c e p s d))

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.commit_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem commit_contract (c e : Slice U8) (p s d : Bool) :
    release.commit_allowed c e p s d = ok true ↔ commitPolicy c e p s d

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.no_unpersisted_commit
theorems.statement:
theorem no_unpersisted_commit (c e : Slice U8) (p d : Bool) :
    release.commit_allowed c e p false d = ok false

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.no_stale_commit
theorems.statement:
theorem no_stale_commit (c e : Slice U8) (p s d : Bool) (h : c.val ≠ e.val) :
    release.commit_allowed c e p s d = ok false

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.no_draining_commit
theorems.statement:
theorem no_draining_commit (c e : Slice U8) (p s : Bool) :
    release.commit_allowed c e p s true = ok false

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.admission_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem admission_eq (a p t : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.admission_allowed a p t d = ok (decide (d = false ∧ a.val < 12 ∧ p.val < 6 ∧ 0 < t.val))

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.admission_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem admission_contract (a p t : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.admission_allowed a p t d = ok true ↔ d = false ∧ a.val < 12 ∧ p.val < 6 ∧ 0 < t.val

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.admission_no_exhausted_tokens
theorems.statement:
theorem admission_no_exhausted_tokens (a p : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.admission_allowed a p 0#u64 d = ok false

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.admission_no_draining
theorems.statement:
theorem admission_no_draining (a p t : U64) :
    release.admission_allowed a p t true = ok false

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.rejection_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem rejection_eq (a p t : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.admission_rejection a p t d = ok
      (if d then 1#u64 else if 12 ≤ a.val then 2#u64 else
       if 6 ≤ p.val then 3#u64 else if t.val = 0 then 4#u64 else 0#u64)

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.rejection_accepts_exactly
theorems.statement:
theorem rejection_accepts_exactly (a p t : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.admission_rejection a p t d = ok 0#u64 ↔
      release.admission_allowed a p t d = ok true

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.rejection_code_bounded
theorems.statement:
theorem rejection_code_bounded (a p t c : U64) (d : Bool)
    (h : release.admission_rejection a p t d = ok c) : c.val ≤ 4

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.rejection_draining
theorems.statement:
theorem rejection_draining (a p t : U64) :
    release.admission_rejection a p t true = ok 1#u64

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.rejection_exhausted
theorems.statement:
theorem rejection_exhausted (a p : U64) (ha : a.val < 12) (hp : p.val < 6) :
    release.admission_rejection a p 0#u64 false = ok 4#u64

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.rejection_total
theorems.statement:
theorem rejection_total (a p t : U64) (d : Bool) :
    ∃ c, release.admission_rejection a p t d = ok c

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_global_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_global_eq (n : Bool) :
    release.capacity_global n = ok (if n then 256#u64 else 12#u64)

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_peer_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_peer_eq (n : Bool) :
    release.capacity_peer n = ok (if n then 192#u64 else 6#u64)

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_queue_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_queue_eq (n : Bool) :
    release.capacity_queue n = ok (if n then 252#u64 else 8#u64)

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_rate_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_rate_eq (n p : Bool) :
    release.capacity_rate n p = ok
      (if n then (if p then 256#u64 else 512#u64) else (if p then 8#u64 else 64#u64))

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_burst_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_burst_eq (n p : Bool) :
    release.capacity_burst n p = ok
      (if n then (if p then 384#u64 else 512#u64) else (if p then 16#u64 else 128#u64))

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_limits_bounded
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_limits_bounded (n : Bool) (g p q : U64)
    (hg : release.capacity_global n = ok g)
    (hp : release.capacity_peer n = ok p)
    (hq : release.capacity_queue n = ok q) :
    0 < p.val ∧ p.val < g.val ∧ g.val ≤ 256 ∧ q.val + 4 = g.val

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_credit_bounded
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_credit_bounded (n p : Bool) (r b : U64)
    (hr : release.capacity_rate n p = ok r)
    (hb : release.capacity_burst n p = ok b) :
    0 < r.val ∧ r.val ≤ 512 ∧ r.val ≤ b.val ∧ b.val ≤ 512 ∧
      60000 * r.val + 1000 * b.val < 2^64

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_rejection_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_rejection_eq (a p t : U64) (d n : Bool) :
    release.capacity_rejection a p t d n = ok
      (if d then 1#u64 else if (if n then 256 else 12) ≤ a.val then 2#u64 else
       if (if n then 192 else 6) ≤ p.val then 3#u64 else if t.val = 0 then 4#u64 else 0#u64)

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_accepts_exactly
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_accepts_exactly (a p t : U64) (d n : Bool) :
    release.capacity_rejection a p t d n = ok 0#u64 ↔
      d = false ∧ a.val < (if n then 256 else 12) ∧
        p.val < (if n then 192 else 6) ∧ 0 < t.val

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_standard_unchanged
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_standard_unchanged (a p t : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.capacity_rejection a p t d false = release.admission_rejection a p t d

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_code_bounded
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_code_bounded (a p t c : U64) (d n : Bool)
    (h : release.capacity_rejection a p t d n = ok c) : c.val ≤ 4

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_no_draining
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_no_draining (a p t : U64) (n : Bool) :
    release.capacity_rejection a p t true n = ok 1#u64

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_no_credit
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_no_credit (a p : U64) (n : Bool)
    (ha : a.val < (if n then 256 else 12))
    (hp : p.val < (if n then 192 else 6)) :
    release.capacity_rejection a p 0#u64 false n = ok 4#u64

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_total
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_total (a p t : U64) (d n : Bool) :
    ∃ c, release.capacity_rejection a p t d n = ok c

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_reload_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_reload_eq (current candidate : Bool) :
    release.capacity_reload_allowed current candidate = ok (decide (current = candidate))

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_reload_unchanged
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_reload_unchanged (current candidate : Bool)
    (h : release.capacity_reload_allowed current candidate = ok true) : current = candidate

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.capacity_reload_total
theorems.statement:
theorem capacity_reload_total (current candidate : Bool) :
    ∃ b, release.capacity_reload_allowed current candidate = ok b

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.gates_total
theorems.statement:
theorem gates_total (c e : Slice U8) (p s d : Bool) (a n t : U64) :
    (∃ b, release.commit_allowed c e p s d = ok b) ∧
    (∃ b, release.admission_allowed a n t d = ok b)

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.dispatch_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem dispatch_eq (a p : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.dispatch_allowed a p d = ok (decide (d = false ∧ a.val < 4 ∧ p.val < 2))

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.dispatch_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem dispatch_contract (a p : U64) (d : Bool) :
    release.dispatch_allowed a p d = ok true ↔ d = false ∧ a.val < 4 ∧ p.val < 2

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.dispatch_bounded
theorems.statement:
theorem dispatch_bounded (a p : U64) (d : Bool)
    (h : release.dispatch_allowed a p d = ok true) : a.val + 1 ≤ 4 ∧ p.val + 1 ≤ 2

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.dispatch_no_draining
theorems.statement:
theorem dispatch_no_draining (a p : U64) :
    release.dispatch_allowed a p true = ok false

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.dispatch_total
theorems.statement:
theorem dispatch_total (a p : U64) (d : Bool) :
    ∃ b, release.dispatch_allowed a p d = ok b

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.migration_eq

theorem migration_eq (c i : Slice U8) (r p b s : Bool) :

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.migration_contract

    release.migration_allowed c i r p b s = ok true ↔ migrationPolicy c i r p b s

theorem migration_no_stale (c i : Slice U8) (r p b s : Bool) (h : c.val ≠ i.val) :

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.migration_no_unready

theorem migration_no_unready (c i : Slice U8) (p b s : Bool) :

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.migration_no_mismatch

theorem migration_no_mismatch (c i : Slice U8) (r b s : Bool) :

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.migration_requires_rollback
theorems.statement:
theorem migration_requires_rollback (c i : Slice U8) (r p s : Bool) :

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.migration_requires_isolation
theorems.statement:
theorem migration_requires_isolation (c i : Slice U8) (r p b : Bool) :
    release.migration_allowed c i r p b false = ok false

theorems.name: ReleaseProofs.migration_total
theorems.statement:
theorem migration_total (c i : Slice U8) (r p b s : Bool) :
    ∃ result, release.migration_allowed c i r p b s = ok result

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_eq (l : U16) (e r : Bool) :
    response.authority_port l e r = ok (if e then 443#u16 else if r then 80#u16 else l)

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_tls
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_tls (l : U16) (r : Bool) :
    response.authority_port l true r = ok 443#u16

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_redirect
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_redirect (l : U16) :
    response.authority_port l false true = ok 80#u16

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_direct
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_direct (l : U16) :
    response.authority_port l false false = ok l

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_allowed_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_allowed_eq (p : Option U16) (e : U16) :
    response.authority_port_allowed p e = ok (decide (e ≠ 0#u16 ∧ (p = none ∨ p = some e)))

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_contract (p : Option U16) (e : U16) :
    response.authority_port_allowed p e = ok true ↔ e ≠ 0#u16 ∧ (p = none ∨ p = some e)

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_no_mismatch
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_no_mismatch (p e : U16)
    (h : response.authority_port_allowed (some p) e = ok true) : p = e

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_no_zero
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_no_zero (p : Option U16) :
    response.authority_port_allowed p 0#u16 = ok false

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.authority_port_total
theorems.statement:
theorem authority_port_total (l e : U16) (t r : Bool) (p : Option U16) :
    (∃ port, response.authority_port l t r = ok port) ∧
    (∃ b, response.authority_port_allowed p e = ok b)

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.forwarded_port_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem forwarded_port_eq (p : Option U16) (e : U16) (t : Bool) :
    response.forwarded_port p e t = ok
      (if e ≠ 0#u16 ∧ p = some e ∧ e ≠ (if t then 443#u16 else 80#u16)
       then e else 0#u16)

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.forwarded_port_trusted
theorems.statement:
theorem forwarded_port_trusted (p : Option U16) (e v : U16) (t : Bool)
    (h : response.forwarded_port p e t = ok v) (hv : v ≠ 0#u16) :
    v = e ∧ p = some e

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.forwarded_port_omitted
theorems.statement:
theorem forwarded_port_omitted (e : U16) (t : Bool) :
    response.forwarded_port none e t = ok 0#u16

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.forwarded_port_mismatch
theorems.statement:
theorem forwarded_port_mismatch (p e : U16) (t : Bool) (h : p ≠ e) :
    response.forwarded_port (some p) e t = ok 0#u16

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.forwarded_port_standard
theorems.statement:
theorem forwarded_port_standard (e : U16) (t : Bool) :
    response.forwarded_port (some (if t then 443#u16 else 80#u16)) e t = ok 0#u16

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.forwarded_port_total
theorems.statement:
theorem forwarded_port_total (p : Option U16) (e : U16) (t : Bool) :
    ∃ v, response.forwarded_port p e t = ok v

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.visible_loop_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem visible_loop_eq (p : Slice U8) (i : Usize) (_hi : i.val ≤ p.val.length) :
    response.visible_loop p i = ok ((p.val.drop i.val).all visibleByte)

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.visible_eq
theorems.statement: theorem visible_eq (p : Slice U8) : response.visible p = ok (p.val.all visibleByte)

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.host_loop_eq

theorem host_loop_eq (p : Slice U8) (i : Usize) (_hi : i.val ≤ p.val.length) :

theorems.name: ResponseProofs.header_name_eq

theorems.name: ServingProofs.authorize_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem authorize_eq (m h c t : Slice U8) (rs : Slice rules.Publication) :
    serving.authorize m h c t rs = ok (authorizeResult m h c t rs)

theorems.name: ServingProofs.authorize_total
theorems.statement:
theorem authorize_total (m h c t : Slice U8) (rs : Slice rules.Publication) :
    ∃ result, serving.authorize m h c t rs = ok result

theorems.name: ServingProofs.authorize_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem authorize_contract (m h c t : Slice U8) (rs : Slice rules.Publication) (g : serving.Grant) :
    serving.authorize m h c t rs = ok (some g) ↔
      (m.val = getBytes ∨ m.val = headBytes) ∧ h.val = c.val ∧
      g.send_body = (m.val == getBytes) ∧
      ∃ p, serving.request_path t = ok (some p) ∧ rules.lookup p rs = ok (some g.target)

theorems.name: ServingProofs.deny_wrong_host
theorems.statement:
theorem deny_wrong_host (m h c t : Slice U8) (rs : Slice rules.Publication)
    (hne : h.val ≠ c.val) : serving.authorize m h c t rs = ok none

theorems.name: ServingProofs.deny_wrong_method
theorems.statement:
theorem deny_wrong_method (m h c t : Slice U8) (rs : Slice rules.Publication)
    (hg : m.val ≠ getBytes) (hh : m.val ≠ headBytes) :
    serving.authorize m h c t rs = ok none

theorems.name: ServingProofs.head_has_no_body
theorems.statement:
theorem head_has_no_body (m h c t : Slice U8) (rs : Slice rules.Publication) (g : serving.Grant)
    (hm : m.val = headBytes) (hg : serving.authorize m h c t rs = ok (some g)) :
    g.send_body = false

theorems.name: ServingProofs.granted_target_safe
theorems.statement:
theorem granted_target_safe (m h c t : Slice U8) (rs : Slice rules.Publication) (g : serving.Grant)
    (hg : serving.authorize m h c t rs = ok (some g)) :
    targetCanonical g.target.val = true ∧
      ∃ p, serving.request_path t = ok (some p) ∧
        canonical p.val = true ∧ ∃ r ∈ rs.val, p.val = r.path.val ∧ r.target = g.target

theorems.name: ServingProofs.file_allowed_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem file_allowed_eq (p o : serving.FileFacts) :
    serving.file_allowed p o = ok (decide (filePolicy p o))

theorems.name: ServingProofs.file_allowed_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem file_allowed_contract (p o : serving.FileFacts) :
    serving.file_allowed p o = ok true ↔ filePolicy p o

theorems.name: ServingProofs.file_allowed_total
theorems.statement:
theorem file_allowed_total (p o : serving.FileFacts) :
    ∃ result, serving.file_allowed p o = ok result

theorems.name: ServingProofs.file_identity_preserved
theorems.statement:
theorem file_identity_preserved (p o : serving.FileFacts)
    (h : serving.file_allowed p o = ok true) :
    p.device = o.device ∧ p.inode = o.inode ∧ p.size = o.size

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.request_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem request_eq (e g u v k o : Bool) (l p : U64) :
    streaming.upgrade_request e g l p u v k o = ok (decide (e = true ∧ g = true ∧ l.val = 0 ∧ p.val = 0 ∧ u = true ∧ v = true ∧ k = true ∧ o = true))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.response_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem response_eq (r v u a p x l t : Bool) (s : U16) :
    streaming.upgrade_response r v s u a p x l t = ok (decide (r = true ∧ v = true ∧ s.val = 101 ∧ u = true ∧ a = true ∧ p = true ∧ x = true ∧ l = false ∧ t = false))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.disabled_request
theorems.statement: theorem disabled_request (g u v k o : Bool) (l p : U64) : streaming.upgrade_request false g l p u v k o = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.no_unrequested_upgrade
theorems.statement: theorem no_unrequested_upgrade (v u a p x l t : Bool) (s : U16) : streaming.upgrade_response false v s u a p x l t = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.request_bodyless
theorems.statement:
theorem request_bodyless (e g u v k o : Bool) (l p : U64) (h : streaming.upgrade_request e g l p u v k o = ok true) :
    l.val = 0 ∧ p.val = 0 ∧ g = true ∧ o = true

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.upgrade_no_http_framing
theorems.statement:
theorem upgrade_no_http_framing (r v u a p x l t : Bool) (s : U16) (h : streaming.upgrade_response r v s u a p x l t = ok true) :
    r = true ∧ s.val = 101 ∧ a = true ∧ p = true ∧ x = true ∧ l = false ∧ t = false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.invalid_accept
theorems.statement: theorem invalid_accept (r v u p x l t : Bool) (s : U16) : streaming.upgrade_response r v s u false p x l t = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.invalid_extensions
theorems.statement: theorem invalid_extensions (r v u a p l t : Bool) (s : U16) : streaming.upgrade_response r v s u a p false l t = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.sse_eq
theorems.statement: theorem sse_eq (e h m c : Bool) (s : U16) : streaming.sse_response e h s m c = ok (decide (e = true ∧ h = false ∧ s.val = 200 ∧ m = true ∧ c = false))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.no_encoded_sse
theorems.statement: theorem no_encoded_sse (e h m : Bool) (s : U16) : streaming.sse_response e h s m true = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.byte_limit_eq
theorems.statement: theorem byte_limit_eq (l : U64) : streaming.byte_limit l = ok (decide (0 < l.val ∧ l.val ≤ 1073741824))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.bytes_eq
theorems.statement: theorem bytes_eq (u n l : U64) : streaming.bytes_fit u n l = ok (decide (0 < l.val ∧ l.val ≤ 1073741824 ∧ u.val + n.val ≤ l.val))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.bytes_bounded
theorems.statement:
theorem bytes_bounded (u n l : U64) (h : streaming.bytes_fit u n l = ok true) :
    u.val + n.val ≤ l.val ∧ l.val ≤ 1073741824

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.time_eq
theorems.statement: theorem time_eq (i t : U64) : streaming.time_limits i t = ok (decide (100 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 300000 ∧ i.val ≤ t.val ∧ t.val ≤ 3600000))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.running_eq
theorems.statement: theorem running_eq (s : Bool) (e q i t : U64) : streaming.running s e q i t = ok (decide (s = false ∧ 100 ≤ i.val ∧ i.val ≤ 300000 ∧ i.val ≤ t.val ∧ t.val ≤ 3600000 ∧ e.val < t.val ∧ q.val < i.val))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.stop_ends_stream
theorems.statement: theorem stop_ends_stream (e q i t : U64) : streaming.running true e q i t = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.expired_total
theorems.statement: theorem expired_total (s : Bool) (e q i t : U64) (h : t.val ≤ e.val) : streaming.running s e q i t = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.expired_idle
theorems.statement: theorem expired_idle (s : Bool) (e q i t : U64) (h : i.val ≤ q.val) : streaming.running s e q i t = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.admission_eq
theorems.statement: theorem admission_eq (a : U64) (s : Bool) : streaming.admission a s = ok (decide (s = false ∧ a.val < 16))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.admission_bounded
theorems.statement: theorem admission_bounded (a : U64) (s : Bool) (h : streaming.admission a s = ok true) : a.val + 1 ≤ 16

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.no_admission_stopped
theorems.statement: theorem no_admission_stopped (a : U64) : streaming.admission a true = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.limits_total
theorems.statement:
theorem limits_total (a u n l e q i t : U64) (s : Bool) :
    (∃ r, streaming.bytes_fit u n l = ok r) ∧ (∃ r, streaming.time_limits i t = ok r) ∧
    (∃ r, streaming.running s e q i t = ok r) ∧ (∃ r, streaming.admission a s = ok r)

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.peer_eq
theorems.statement: theorem peer_eq (a p : U64) (s : Bool) : streaming.peer_admission a p s = ok (decide (s = false ∧ a.val < 16 ∧ p.val < 8))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.peer_bounded
theorems.statement: theorem peer_bounded (a p : U64) (s : Bool) (h : streaming.peer_admission a p s = ok true) : a.val + 1 ≤ 16 ∧ p.val + 1 ≤ 8 ∧ s = false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.service_limit_eq
theorems.statement: theorem service_limit_eq (n : U64) : streaming.service_limit n = ok (decide (0 < n.val ∧ n.val ≤ 16))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.service_eq
theorems.statement: theorem service_eq (a c l : U64) : streaming.service_admission a c l = ok (decide (0 < c.val ∧ c.val ≤ 16 ∧ 0 < l.val ∧ l.val ≤ 16 ∧ a.val < c.val ∧ a.val < l.val))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.service_bounded_across_reload
theorems.statement: theorem service_bounded_across_reload (a c l : U64) (h : streaming.service_admission a c l = ok true) : a.val + 1 ≤ c.val ∧ a.val + 1 ≤ l.val ∧ l.val ≤ 16

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.revoked_service
theorems.statement: theorem revoked_service (a c : U64) : streaming.service_admission a c 0#u64 = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.origin_eq
theorems.statement: theorem origin_eq (p s l : Bool) : streaming.origin_allowed p s l = ok (decide (p = false ∨ s = true ∨ l = true))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.foreign_origin_requires_allowlist
theorems.statement: theorem foreign_origin_requires_allowlist (s l : Bool) (hs : s = false) (h : streaming.origin_allowed true s l = ok true) : l = true

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.origin_denied
theorems.statement: theorem origin_denied : streaming.origin_allowed true false false = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.deflate_eq
theorems.statement: theorem deflate_eq (e o s a b p : Bool) : streaming.deflate_allowed e o s a b p = ok (decide (s = false ∨ (e = true ∧ o = true ∧ a = true ∧ b = true ∧ p = true)))

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.deflate_requires_opt_in_offer_and_resets
theorems.statement: theorem deflate_requires_opt_in_offer_and_resets (e o a b p : Bool) (h : streaming.deflate_allowed e o true a b p = ok true) : e = true ∧ o = true ∧ a = true ∧ b = true ∧ p = true

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.no_unsolicited_deflate
theorems.statement: theorem no_unsolicited_deflate (e a b p : Bool) : streaming.deflate_allowed e false true a b p = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.no_context_takeover
theorems.statement: theorem no_context_takeover (e o p : Bool) : streaming.deflate_allowed e o true false true p = ok false ∧ streaming.deflate_allowed e o true true false p = ok false

theorems.name: StreamingProofs.optional_uncompressed
theorems.statement: theorem optional_uncompressed (e o a b p : Bool) : streaming.deflate_allowed e o false a b p = ok true

theorems.name: TlsProofs.identity_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem identity_eq (s h c : Slice U8) :
    tls.identity_allowed s h c = ok (decide (s.val ≠ [] ∧ s.val = h.val ∧ h.val = c.val))

theorems.name: TlsProofs.identity_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem identity_contract (s h c : Slice U8) :
    tls.identity_allowed s h c = ok true ↔ s.val ≠ [] ∧ s.val = h.val ∧ h.val = c.val

theorems.name: TlsProofs.no_domain_fronting
theorems.statement:
theorem no_domain_fronting (s h c : Slice U8) (hne : s.val ≠ h.val) :
    tls.identity_allowed s h c = ok false

theorems.name: TlsProofs.no_missing_sni
theorems.statement:
theorem no_missing_sni (h c : Slice U8) (s : Slice U8) (he : s.val = []) :
    tls.identity_allowed s h c = ok false

theorems.name: TlsProofs.secret_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem secret_eq (p o : tls.SecretFacts) (uid : U32) :
    tls.secret_allowed p o uid = ok (decide (secretPolicy p o uid))

theorems.name: TlsProofs.secret_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem secret_contract (p o : tls.SecretFacts) (uid : U32) :
    tls.secret_allowed p o uid = ok true ↔ secretPolicy p o uid

theorems.name: TlsProofs.no_public_secret
theorems.statement:
theorem no_public_secret (p o : tls.SecretFacts) (uid : U32) (hm : o.mode ≠ 384#u32) :
    tls.secret_allowed p o uid = ok false

theorems.name: TlsProofs.secret_identity
theorems.statement:
theorem secret_identity (p o : tls.SecretFacts) (uid : U32)
    (h : tls.secret_allowed p o uid = ok true) : p.device = o.device ∧ p.inode = o.inode

theorems.name: TlsProofs.activate_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem activate_eq (b e n : U64) (k h p : Bool) :
    tls.activate b e n k h p = ok (decide (k = true ∧ h = true ∧ p = true ∧ b.val ≤ n.val ∧ n.val < e.val))

theorems.name: TlsProofs.activate_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem activate_contract (b e n : U64) (k h p : Bool) :
    tls.activate b e n k h p = ok true ↔ k = true ∧ h = true ∧ p = true ∧ b.val ≤ n.val ∧ n.val < e.val

theorems.name: TlsProofs.no_unpersisted_activation
theorems.statement:
theorem no_unpersisted_activation (b e n : U64) (k h : Bool) :
    tls.activate b e n k h false = ok false

theorems.name: TlsProofs.no_expired_activation
theorems.statement:
theorem no_expired_activation (b e n : U64) (k h p : Bool) (hex : e.val ≤ n.val) :
    tls.activate b e n k h p = ok false

theorems.name: TlsProofs.renewal_eq
theorems.statement: theorem renewal_eq (b e n : U64) : tls.renewal_due b e n = ok (decide (renewPolicy b e n))

theorems.name: TlsProofs.renewal_contract
theorems.statement:
theorem renewal_contract (b e n : U64) :
    tls.renewal_due b e n = ok true ↔ renewPolicy b e n

theorems.name: TlsProofs.renew_at_expiration
theorems.statement:
theorem renew_at_expiration (b e n : U64) (h : e.val ≤ n.val) :
    tls.renewal_due b e n = ok true

theorems.name: TlsProofs.lifecycle_total
theorems.statement:
theorem lifecycle_total (b e n : U64) (k h p : Bool) :
    (∃ result, tls.activate b e n k h p = ok result) ∧
    (∃ result, tls.renewal_due b e n = ok result)

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.probe_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem probe_eq (g c r : Bool) (b n : U64) :
    upstream.probe_allowed g b c r n = ok (decide (g = true ∧ b.val = 0 ∧ c = false ∧ r = true ∧ 0 < n.val ∧ n.val ≤ 32))

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.probe_read_only
theorems.statement:
theorem probe_read_only (g c r : Bool) (b n : U64)
    (h : upstream.probe_allowed g b c r n = ok true) :
    g = true ∧ b.val = 0 ∧ c = false

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.probe_bounded
theorems.statement:
theorem probe_bounded (g c r : Bool) (b n : U64)
    (h : upstream.probe_allowed g b c r n = ok true) : 0 < n.val ∧ n.val ≤ 32

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.next_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem next_eq (s : U16) (n : U64) :
    upstream.probe_next s n = ok (decide (s = 404#u16 ∧ 0 < n.val ∧ n.val < 32))

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.only_absence_falls_through
theorems.statement:
theorem only_absence_falls_through (s : U16) (n : U64)
    (h : upstream.probe_next s n = ok true) : s = 404#u16

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.no_retry_after_last
theorems.statement: theorem no_retry_after_last (s : U16) : upstream.probe_next s 0#u64 = ok false

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.owned_eq
theorems.statement:
theorem owned_eq (s : U16) : upstream.probe_owned s = ok (decide
    ((200 ≤ s.val ∧ s.val < 300) ∨ s = 401#u16 ∨ s = 403#u16 ∨ s = 410#u16))

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.authorization_is_final
theorems.statement:
theorem authorization_is_final (n : U64) :
    upstream.probe_owned 401#u16 = ok true ∧ upstream.probe_next 401#u16 n = ok false ∧
    upstream.probe_owned 403#u16 = ok true ∧ upstream.probe_next 403#u16 n = ok false

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.gone_is_final
theorems.statement: theorem gone_is_final (n : U64) : upstream.probe_owned 410#u16 = ok true ∧ upstream.probe_next 410#u16 n = ok false

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.server_error_is_not_owner
theorems.statement: theorem server_error_is_not_owner (s : U16) (h : 500 ≤ s.val) : upstream.probe_owned s = ok false

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.query_eq
theorems.statement: theorem query_eq (e a : Bool) : upstream.query_match e a = ok (e || a)

theorems.name: UpstreamProofs.encoded_query_applies
theorems.statement: theorem encoded_query_applies (e : Bool) : upstream.query_match e true = ok true
